LanguageData.WSR_GameStartDialog:
Less grinding. Less downtime. More action!

Wave Survival skips most of the slow early-game gathering of vanilla RimWorld. Build your base quickly, then defend it from wave after wave of raiders until your colony inevitably collapses spectacularly.

Build an orbital trade beacon to receive the daily supply drops. The first wave arrives in five days.
LanguageData.WSR_WaveTimerSpecial: This is a special wave: expect a siege, sappers, or maddened animals.
LanguageData.WSR_NeedBeaconExplanation: Wave Survival drops supplies by pod at your orbital trade beacon once a day. Until you build one, no supplies arrive.\n\nBuild one as soon as you can.
LanguageData.WSR_SupplyDropArrived: A supply drop has landed at the trade beacon.
